messages:
incident-bot: Pager: high egress rate observed to telemetry-vendor.prod (external). PagerID PGR-9921
alex: noticed spike from telemetry-proxy to telemetry-vendor.prod
maria: sampled payloads — includes headers and bodies. Saw `Authorization: Bearer svc-` in raw egress :grimacing:
sre-liz: Taking oncall. Immediate actions: block egress, rotate tokens, preserve evidence. @ops-rafa block egress for telemetry-proxy now
ops-rafa: Adding outbound deny on sg-telemetry. Command: `aws ec2 revoke-security-group-egress --group-id sg-telemetry --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0` -> applied :white_check_mark:
sec-sam: Which tokens? service-to-service or customer tokens?
maria: Found svc-metric-collector and svc-forwarder tokens. No emails in sample but need full scan of last 24h logs.
alex: Running grep for 'Authorization: Bearer svc-' across egress logs. Output path /tmp/egress-scan-1769993333.log
alex: ~180 matches mostly to telemetry-vendor.prod subdomains from two host pools.
ops-rafa: Rotating svc-forwarder now. Creating new secret in Secrets Manager and triggering rollout to telemetry-proxy.
ops-rafa: `aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id svc-forwarder --secret-string "<new>"` then rolling restart (canary)
maria: Uploading sampled payloads to internal S3 path (restricted) /investigations/INC-1769993333/samples.json
sec-sam: Mark tokens compromised. Notify downstream teams to rotate any keys that accept forwarded auth headers.
sre-liz: Legal @legal-jane looped. product @product-helen FYI in case any customers are affected.
legal-jane: Acknowledge. Need final blast radius and data types before any external comms. Prepare internal notification template.
ops-rafa: Rollout finished. Canary healthy 1/4 then 4/4. New tokens live. Old tokens revoked.
alex: Full scan indicates no customer endpoints contacted. Only telemetry-vendor domains. Blast radius limited to internal service tokens.
sec-sam: Good. Still need postmortem: why proxies forwarded Authorization header? Add filter to strip sensitive headers by default.
product-helen: If vendor confirms receipt, we may need to notify impacted integrations. Keep me updated.
sre-liz: Opened INC-1769993333 and a tracking board. Triage owners: eng-runtime (root cause), security (controls), ops (rotation). I'm incident lead until 07:00 PST handoff.
incident-bot: INC created INC-1769993333 severity P2 channel #incidents
sre-liz: Handoff notes: egress blocked, tokens rotated/revoked, ingestion resumed with header-stripping enabled, legal engaged, no customer PII observed. Next: RCA, egress deny whitelist, and alert on outgoing Authorization headers.
ops-rafa: Artifacts saved: /investigations/INC-1769993333/egress-scan.log and /investigations/INC-1769993333/rotation.md
maria: Re-enabled pipeline with forwarding disabled. Running a 2-hour audit job.
sec-sam: Follow-ups: add feature-flag gate for third-party forwarding, implement egress allowlists per env, and add detection for outbound auth tokens.
legal-jane: Preparing statement template; will coordinate with comms if vendor confirms data retention.
alex: Closing pager for now. Will update the incident channel if anything else appears :white_check_mark:
